# PCA tidyverse style

## Loading Libraries

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("broom")
library("cowplot")
```

## Load Data

```{r}
biopsy <- read_csv("https://wilkelab.org/classes/SDS348/data_sets/biopsy.csv")
```

## Look at the data in PC coordinates 1

Looking at the dimensions of the dataset

```{r}
dim(biopsy)
```

looking at the data.

```{r}
slice_sample(biopsy, n = 10)
```

we start by making a pca fit

```{r}

pca_fit <- biopsy |> 
  select(-outcome) |> #selecting everything but outcome
  prcomp(scale = TRUE)
```

```{r}
pca_fit |> 
  augment(biopsy) |> 
  ggplot(
    aes(.fittedPC1, .fittedPC2, color = outcome))+
    geom_point(size = 1)+
      scale_color_manual(
        values = c(malignant ="black",benign = "green" )
      )+
      theme_half_open(12)+
      background_grid()
```
